sloka: सखीवच्च विगाहस्व सीते मन्दाकिनीं नदीम् ।कमलान्यवमज्जन्ती पुष्कराणि च भामिनि ॥ २.९५.१४॥
transliteration: sakhīvacca vigāhasva sīte mandākinīṁ nadīm ।kamalānyavamajjantī puṣkarāṇi ca bhāmini ॥ 2.95.14॥

translations.english: O lovely Sita, like a companion plunge into this river Mandakini, submerging the red and white lotuses, and enjoy sporting.
